attchmntText: Signet Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Signet Industries Limited reported unaudited financial results for the half year ended 30th September 2026. Revenue from operations stood at 64011.87 lacs, compared to 56602.98 lacs in the previous year. Profit before tax was 2152.41 lacs, up from 589.53 lacs. Profit after tax for the period was 1561.11 lacs, against 415.24 lacs previously. Cash flow from operating activities was 5528.30 lacs. Net cash flow from investing activities was negative 2566.90 lacs due to purchases of property, plant, and equipment. Net cash flow from financing activities was negative 2960.68 lacs, driven by finance costs paid and borrowings repayment. Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period were 28.55 lacs. The results were reviewed by SMAK & Co, Chartered Accountants, who found no material misstatements. The Board of Directors approved the statement.
